// Smoke test for the built server: pages, middleware redirect, cart cookie behaviour.
const base = process.argv[2] || 'http://localhost:3917'

async function get(path, cookie) {
  const res = await fetch(base + path, { redirect: 'manual', headers: cookie ? { cookie } : {} })
  return { status: res.status, location: res.headers.get('location'), html: await res.text() }
}

const products = await (await fetch(base + '/api/products')).json()
const slug = products[0].slug
const cartCookie = v => `cart=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(v))}`

const results = {}
results.home = (await get('/')).status
results.product = (await get(`/products/${slug}`)).status
results.cartEmpty = (await get('/cart')).status
results.checkoutEmptyRedirect = await get('/checkout')
results.checkoutWithCart = await get('/checkout', `${cartCookie([{ slug, qty: 2 }])}; discount-code=SAVE10`)
results.cartWithItem = await get('/cart', cartCookie([{ slug, qty: 2 }]))
results.cartWithUnknown = await get('/cart', cartCookie([{ slug: 'nope', qty: 1 }]))

const summary = o => ({ status: o.status, location: o.location ?? undefined })
console.log('home', results.home, 'product', results.product, 'cart(empty)', results.cartEmpty)
console.log('checkout(empty cart)', summary(results.checkoutEmptyRedirect))
console.log('checkout(cart+SAVE10)', summary(results.checkoutWithCart))
const pick = (html, re) => (html.match(re) || [])[0] ?? null
const co = results.checkoutWithCart.html
console.log('  subtotal:', pick(co, /id="cart-subtotal">[^<]*/), ' total:', pick(co, /id="cart-total">[^<]*/), ' discount line:', pick(co, /Discount:[^<]*/))
console.log('  header badge:', pick(co, /cart-badge[^>]*>\s*\d+/))
const cw = results.cartWithItem.html
console.log('cart(with item)', results.cartWithItem.status, 'items:', (cw.match(/class="cart-item"/g) || []).length, ' total:', pick(cw, /id="cart-total">[^<]*/), ' badge:', pick(cw, /cart-badge[^>]*>\s*\d+/))
const cu = results.cartWithUnknown.html
console.log('cart(unknown slug)', results.cartWithUnknown.status, 'items:', (cu.match(/class="cart-item"/g) || []).length, ' name shown:', pick(cu, /class="name">[^<]*/))
